apps.localizedDescription:
Bird Chaser (iOS):

A self-contained iPhone app for personal eBird target tracking, built with Capacitor. It is a native app you sideload onto your own device — no App Store, no paid Apple Developer account.

🐍 Looking for the Python pipeline, the backlog, or the release runbook? They live in the sibling repository birding (private).

Two repositories, and why:

The project is split in two, and you can land in either one. Here is the map.

versions.localizedDescription:
v1.184.0 — clearer setup, refined alerts and accessible WATCH colours:

• F1251: eBird account connection announces Please wait immediately and clears its pending state when the actual connection attempt settles.
• F1252: initial acquisition precedes the final setup summary. A separate result box honestly distinguishes verified data from partial or unavailable groups; Start birding opens Home.
• F1253: measured source recovery and diagnostics preserve successful/partial data without pretending a blocked provider succeeded. Leaderboard counts distinguish acquisition, parsing, retention, grouping and rendering.
• F1254: Getting Ready shows actual initial-source activity and automatic continuation, rather than an unexplained lingering loading screen.
• F1255: Full and Recent Busy alerts use actual inclusive five-times-usual qualification, not a rounded display multiplier. The ordinary Busy menu is unchanged.
• F1256: category controls show icons, counts and status; complete category names remain in accessible labels. Filtering and selected-state feedback are retained.
• F1257: Full and Recent Migration alerts retain verified High only. The dedicated Migration section and its source classifications remain unchanged.
• F1258: Recent timestamps occupy a reserved right-hand column on the first text row. Long names wrap within their available space without extra grid-row height or smaller type/touch targets.
• F1259: local wizard/source/taxonomy/leaderboard diagnostics retain safe counts, lifecycle and first/latest blockers. Debug collection, storage, display, Dump, copy and package metadata omit/redact structured personal/location/raw-body information.
• F1260: initial acquisition makes one bounded failed-source recovery pass, reuses successful sources and automatically continues to the final summary after settled partial results. No mandatory Retry or extra prefetch Continue.
• F1261: automatic account/key/Home/seen-list work has immediate wait feedback. Skip explicitly identifies the seen-list check; its longer label may wrap without clipping or smaller text.
• F1262: both Stakeout views display the official PLVI code for Plumbeous Vireo while preserving plsvir for provider requests and actions.
• F1263: setup's initial-data count/loading/retry presentation stays inside the wizard, never on Home after Close or completion. Ordinary refresh and retained caches continue normally.
• F1265: Add Watch uses bluish green #009E73; Remove Watch uses vermillion #D55E00. Black text/borders and explicit Add/Remove labels remain. Measured normal-text contrast is 6.14:1 and 5.43:1; these meet AA, not the superseded lighter-fill 7:1 target.

Limits and installation:

The downloadable BirdChaser-unsigned.ipa is for sideloading with AltStore/AltServer; it is not the signed TestFlight installation. Signed delivery, Apple processing, internal-testing eligibility and owner-account visibility are separate observations.

Physical-device interactions not explicitly confirmed are unverified, not hidden successes. F1264's lower WATCH-action placement is queued separately. F1247 stays paused and F1248 parked; none is implemented by this release.
